children: Lovett Scott R., an officer serving as President, Go to Market, sold Class A common stock at a weighted average price of $23.85 per share for total reported proceeds of $830,457 and sold 34,820 shares to satisfy tax obligations related to the vesting of restricted stock units; after the transaction, Lovett directly owned 1,323,398 Class A common stock.

Jeffrey Ford, an officer serving as Principal Accounting Officer, sold Class A common stock at a reported weighted average price of $23.84 per share for total reported proceeds of $884,249 and sold shares to satisfy tax obligations in connection with the vesting of previously granted restricted stock units; following the transaction, Ford directly owned 295,693 Class A common shares.
